departments.name: Department of Computer Applications (BCA / MCA)
departments.head: Mrs. Reena Mol V U
departments.tagline: Excellence in Pedagogy, Research, and Value-Based Education
departments.description: Department of Computer Applications (BCA / MCA) at St. Philomena's College (Autonomous), Mysuru has a distinguished legacy of academic excellence, comprehensive laboratory infrastructure, and research accomplishments.
departments.history: Established with the visionary mission of imparting holistic education, the Department of Computer Applications (BCA / MCA) continues to lead innovative pedagogies and research inquiries.
achievements: Consistent university distinctions and top semester academic performances.
Active student participation in research workshops, internships, and symposiums.
Strong career placements and direct admissions into prestigious postgraduate institutions.
futurePlans: To introduce advanced interdisciplinary research modules and skill-enhancement certificates.
To strengthen industry-academia MoUs and specialized corporate internships.
To host regional and national academic conferences in emerging disciplines.

facultyMembers.name: Mrs. E Gloriya Priyadarshini
facultyMembers.designation: Head of the Department & Assistant Professor

facilities: Departmental specialized reference archives and digital learning resources.
Audio-Visual smart seminar facilities for academic workshops.

programmes.title: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
programmes.eligibility: Candidates who have passed Two Year Pre-University Course (10+2) examination in Science, Commerce or Arts with Mathematics / Computer Science / Statistics / Accountancy / Electronics from recognized boards are eligible.
programmes.overview: The Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) at St. Philomena's College provides comprehensive education in software engineering, database design, web full-stack ecosystems, cloud platforms, and algorithmic computing. The program is designed to bridge the gap between academic theory and high-demand IT industry competencies.
programmes.history: The Department of Computer Science was established in the year 1999 to offer undergraduate education in computing. To meet the expanding requirements of the IT industry, the Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) program was launched to equip students with practical programming and software development skills.
programmes.vision: To be a premier center of technical excellence producing innovative software professionals, ethical technocrats, and visionary entrepreneurs capable of addressing complex global digital challenges.
programmes.mission: To impart comprehensive foundation in core algorithms, full-stack architectures, and AI systems; to foster industry-aligned experiential coding and research; to nurture ethical values and leadership in computing.
achievements: Consistent university rank holders and top academic performance in semester examinations.
Annual technical inter-collegiate symposium 'PhiloTech' organized by BCA student association.
High placement conversion rate in top IT companies (Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, L&T Infotech).
facilities: State-of-the-art Computer Science & Application Laboratories with high-speed internet.
Dedicated Linux and Windows dual-boot development systems with modern IDEs.
Departmental digital reference library and audio-visual seminar hall.
curriculumHighlights: Core Programming Languages: C, C++, Core & Advanced Java, Python, JavaScript
Web Full-Stack: HTML5, CSS3, React.js, Node.js, Express, REST APIs
Database Systems: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, NoSQL Architectures
Cloud & Security: Cloud Computing Fundamentals, Cybersecurity Principles, Software Engineering
careerOpportunities: Higher Studies: Master of Computer Applications (MCA), M.Sc Computer Science

progressionPathway.eligibilityNote: Direct progression to AICTE-approved MCA program for BCA graduates.
progressionPathway.careerAdvantage: Enterprise Software Architect, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Cloud Systems Engineer, AI Specialist.

programmes.title: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
programmes.eligibility: Passed BCA/Bachelor Degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent Degree, OR Passed B.Sc./B.Com./B.A. with Mathematics at 10+2 Level or at Graduation Level with minimum 50% marks (45% for reserved categories). PGCET CODE: C477.
programmes.overview: The Master of Computer Applications (MCA) program is designed to provide postgraduate students with an in-depth education in modern computer technology. This two-year program is dedicated to offering advanced training in programming, algorithmic design, database administration, software engineering, web architectures, networking, cloud systems, and cybersecurity.
programmes.history: The MCA postgraduate programme was established with AICTE approval and University of Mysore affiliation to produce high-caliber software architects, system analysts, and AI developers.
programmes.vision: To be a premier center of technical excellence producing innovative software professionals, ethical technocrats, and visionary entrepreneurs capable of addressing complex global digital challenges.
programmes.mission: To impart comprehensive foundation in core algorithms, full-stack architectures, and AI systems; to foster industry-aligned experiential coding and research; to nurture ethical values and leadership in computing.
achievements: State-of-the-art research lab equipped with high-performance computing systems.
facilities: Dedicated MCA Advanced Computing Laboratory with high-speed fiber connectivity.
Cloud Simulation and AI Sandbox environments.
curriculumHighlights: Semester I: Data Structures & Algorithms, Java Technologies, DBMS, Computer Networks, Operating Systems
Semester II: Python Programming, Software Engineering, Web Technologies, Machine Learning Foundations
Semester III: Cloud Computing, DevOps, Mobile App Development, Information & Cyber Security
Semester IV: Major Industry Capstone Project & Internship, Research Seminar
